'''Harpster''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played Day 2 of the [[2010 World Championship]]. According to his [[Players Committee]] forum signature (captured September 2008), he was the 2008 Washington State Champion, 2008 Federal Way Mini Open Champion, 2008 Seattle Summer League Champion and 2008 Endor Regional Champion.<ref name="pcf-21444-308754">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=308754#308754 Endor Regionals], Harpster, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (21 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915153804/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=21444 Internet Archive]</ref>
